events.subtitle: Cotton Club debut — accordion, voice and custom breath-controlled electronics
events.category: Accordion-led modern jazz-fusion / custom electronic instrument / Tokyo club debut
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Anatole Muster on November 6 and 7, 2026, for his first performance at the venue. November 6 sets start at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM; November 7 sets start at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM. The announced trio is Muster on accordion, vocals and 'breathalyzer,' Hugo Piper on bass, and Ananda Brandão on drums. The venue describes the breathalyzer as a custom MIDI-controlled synthesizer instrument developed with Muster and frames the performance around his accordion-led contemporary jazz-fusion language, including material from the current album hopecore. COTTON CLUB lists the standard table-seat charge at ¥7,700 per person.

en.why_it_matters: The accordion is not a novelty prop here: Muster pairs it with a custom MIDI-controlled breath instrument and a bass-drums trio, treating breath, buttons and electronics as one instrumental system. His first Cotton Club run offers a close-range look at a player connecting Kiefer- and Louis Cole-adjacent modern fusion to an instrument that almost never occupies this role.
en.trip_verdict: If November 6 or 7 overlaps a Tokyo stay, actively make room for one set and let Marunouchi anchor that part of the evening. Four chances provide enough flexibility to work around rarer dates elsewhere in the city.

es.why_it_matters: El acordeón no está aquí como curiosidad: Muster lo conecta con un instrumento de aliento y síntesis MIDI hecho a la medida, más bajo y batería, para tratar respiración, botones y electrónica como un solo sistema instrumental. Su debut en COTTON CLUB permite escuchar de cerca a un músico que acerca la fusión contemporánea del entorno de Kiefer y Louis Cole a un instrumento que casi nunca ocupa este lugar.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 6 o 7 de noviembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los sets y dejaría que Marunouchi ancle esa parte de la noche. Cuatro oportunidades permiten acomodarlo alrededor de fechas más raras en la ciudad.

events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents La Reserve Asia Tour 2026 on November 11, 2026, with sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The announced lineup is Maria Kim on vocals and piano, Lucy Yeghiazaryan on vocals, Caity Gyorgy on vocals, Peng Ji on bass and Gene Jackson on drums. The venue identifies the engagement as Brooklyn-based independent jazz label La Reserve's first Asian concert series and frames the program around Kim's Korean jazz perspective, Yeghiazaryan's Armenian roots and contemporary American jazz approach, and Gyorgy's Canadian swing tradition sharing one stage. COTTON CLUB lists the standard table-seat charge at ¥8,500 per person. General web reservations are scheduled to open September 11, 2026, following a September 8 member presale.

en.why_it_matters: This is more specific than three singers sharing a bill. La Reserve's first Asian concert series uses one rhythm section to place Maria Kim's Korean jazz perspective, Lucy Yeghiazaryan's Armenian-American musical background and Caity Gyorgy's swing-centered Canadian voice in direct conversation. The cultural exchange is built into the performance structure rather than added as marketing around it.
en.trip_verdict: If November 11 is open during a Tokyo stay, catch either set if it fits cleanly. It is a useful one-night snapshot of an international label scene, but I would keep rarer master appearances or singular lineups ahead of it when the calendar conflicts.

es.why_it_matters: Esto es más específico que juntar a tres cantantes en un cartel. La primera serie asiática de conciertos de La Reserve usa una misma sección rítmica para poner en conversación la mirada del jazz coreano de Maria Kim, el trasfondo armenio-estadounidense de Lucy Yeghiazaryan y la voz canadiense de Caity Gyorgy anclada en el swing. El intercambio cultural está metido en la estructura del concierto y no pegado como discurso promocional.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 11 de noviembre queda libre durante una estancia en Tokio, entraría al set que acomode mejor. Es una buena fotografía de una escena internacional reunida por el sello, pero ante un conflicto de calendario dejaría primero una aparición más rara de un maestro o una formación verdaderamente singular.

events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Benny Green in solo piano on November 12, 2026, with sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The venue frames the one-day solo engagement around Green's current album Renovation, identified there as his first solo-piano live album, with repertoire on that recording including a Duke Pearson tribute and compositions associated with Bobby Timmons, Randy Weston and Hoagy Carmichael. Green then remains at COTTON CLUB for separate trio performances November 13-15. COTTON CLUB lists the solo table-seat charge at ¥8,500 per person and separately advertises a limited solo-plus-trio pass.

en.why_it_matters: The solo format is the reason to flag this date. After decades inside hard-bop lineages and ensemble settings, Green brings the repertory documented on his first solo live album into a room where touch, time and harmonic architecture are completely exposed. That makes November 12 a different proposition from the three trio nights that follow rather than simply the first date of a longer residency.
en.trip_verdict: If November 12 overlaps Tokyo, actively make room for one of the two solo sets. The trio run immediately afterward gives plenty of access to Green that week, but the unaccompanied night is the more distinctive date to build a Marunouchi evening around.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para marcar esta fecha es el formato solista. Después de décadas dentro del linaje hard bop y de tocar en ensambles, Green lleva el repertorio documentado en su primer disco en vivo a piano solo a una sala donde quedan completamente expuestos el toque, el tiempo y la arquitectura armónica. Eso vuelve al 12 de noviembre una propuesta distinta de las tres noches de trío que siguen, no simplemente el inicio de una residencia más larga.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 12 de noviembre coincide con Tokio, sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets solistas. La corrida de trío que sigue da muchas oportunidades para escuchar a Green esa semana, pero la noche sin acompañamiento es la fecha más distintiva para construir una velada por Marunouchi.
